name: The Flower from Tiamat's Fire
source:
Banished to centuries of slumber by her own offspring, an ancient force of destruction stirs. You’re an unreliable, awkward fire mage – and the only one standing between her and the fate of the world.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_Flower_from_Tiamat%27s_Fire]romance-club.fandom[/url]
